title: Pip and the Locked Doors

pages.scene_description: Pip standing guard by a row of little lit-up houses.

sentences.text: Pip is a little robot owl.
Pip reads the news at night.

pages.scene_description: Pip in her nest reading a glowing newspaper.

sentences.text: Some hackers used an AI helper to break in.

pages.scene_description: The newspaper shows sneaky raccoons near a computer.

sentences.text: Their AI tried to guess passwords very fast.

pages.scene_description: Many doors in a row, each with a lock.

sentences.text: It got into a company that keeps copies of files.

pages.scene_description: One door is open a crack.

sentences.text: Microsoft spotted the attack and told everyone.

pages.scene_description: A big friendly lighthouse beam shines on the doors.

sentences.text: The company turned off its service to stay safe.
Pip locks her little door tight.

pages.scene_description: Shops close their shutters for the night.

sentences.text: Keep your passwords secret, like a treasure.

pages.scene_description: Pip tucks a tiny key under her wing.

sentences.text: Microsoft shared this news in October.
Microsoft saw many tries to log in.

pages.scene_description: A simple page with two real facts and a little source tag.

sentences.text: Quiz time! Let's see what you remember.

pages.scene_description: Pip holds up three glowing cards.

parent_card.concept: Bad actors can use AI too, so people and companies need good digital locks.
parent_card.background: Microsoft said a hacker group used an AI agent to guess passwords very fast and break into a backup service called ConnectWise Cloud Backup.
parent_card.question: Why do you think we keep our passwords secret?
parent_card.honest_answer: Some people try to break into computers. Strong, secret passwords and good security teams help keep our things safe.

key_facts: Microsoft said hackers used an AI agent in an attack.
The AI tried to guess passwords very fast.
ConnectWise turned off some services to stay safe.
